lesson.meaning: To communicate or express a message, idea, or feeling to someone.
examples: Please convey my appreciation to the entire team for their excellent work.
It's important to convey your feedback clearly during our weekly meetings.
Her quiet tone conveyed a sense of sadness, even without her saying much.
The manager tried to convey the urgency of the project to all stakeholders.
Did my email effectively convey the new policy changes to everyone?
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'convey' as 'carrying' your message or feeling from you to another person. You are carrying the meaning across!
